name: 3D Model Viewer
description: View 3D models in Orca without leaving it: GLB, PLY (meshes and point clouds), OBJ, STL and 3MF. Orbit, zoom and pan, preset views, section plane, measuring, wireframe, textures, and per-part colors and visibility. Export as GLB, STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF, PNG or a turntable video, compress a model under a size, and transform, decimate or check it as a copy. Runs fully offline and asks for no permissions.
